text:
elaine (AE): New deal: MeridianTrust wants a 2-week private POC. RFP highlights: BYO KMS for model keys, must preserve client source IP to their SIEM, absolutely no outbound internet from the cluster, and a filled security questionnaire within 48h. They also want a rough Dedicated quote for sustained 100 rps with spikes to 250.

ravi (Solutions Eng): Options: PrivateLink (interface endpoints per AZ) or VPC peering/transit. PrivateLink isolates routes; peering is simpler for high-throughput but exposes route tables. Both can be made no-internet with proper route tables and SGs.

oscar (NetOps): SNAT is the big risk for srcIP preservation. If their ALB or load balancer SNATs, we lose client IP. Need to know LB vendor/version. If SNAT unavoidable, we can tunnel traffic back to their collector to preserve original IP.

tara (Security): For BYO KMS we need ARN, key policy allowing our service role decrypt/encrypt, and an IAM trust role. We'll provide a template. Note: runtime cannot perform customer HSM attestation; we can use KMS envelope keys only.

lyn (Infra): Egress lockdown approaches: 1) Restrict SGs to only allow PrivateLink VPCEs + their SIEM IPs. 2) Route 0.0.0.0/0 to a blackhole in public subnets. 3) Put an explicit site-to-site tunnel to their proxy and force egress through it. Also flag: OCSP/CRL retrieval may require exceptions if they use cert revocation checks.

elaine (AE): They want a one-page network checklist and the firewall snippet to paste into their change requests. Can we deliver today?

ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare the checklist: VPCE SG rules, required management CIDRs, KMS trust policy example, and quick SNAT detection steps.

oscar (NetOps): Firewall snippet (pasteable):
# Allow app subnets -> VPCE (API)
ALLOW_SRC=10.10.0.0/16
VPCE_DNS=vpce-0abcde12345.prod.vpce
iptables -A FORWARD -s $ALLOW_SRC -d $VPCE_DNS -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT

tara (Security): Security QA lines: "Data residency: data resides in customer's selected region for private deployments. KMS: BYO KMS via cross-account role and envelope encryption. Access: RBAC via SSO, audit logs forwarded on request." I'll tighten wording and drop it in.

lyn (Infra): Latency: Dedicated 4xA10G in eu-west typically achieves p95 ~110-200ms for short completions at 100 rps (model-dependent). For bursts to 250 rps recommend prewarming or temporary capacity bump during POC. Pricing: monthly reserved + overage; I'll DM numbers.

elaine (AE): Scheduling: MeridianTrust wants a 30-min ops call tomorrow 08:30 CET. Tagging @ravi @oscar @tara @lyn to join. notifier-bot: ticket MT-2201 created for POC network runbook.

oscar (NetOps): Quick blocker note: if customer uses managed WAF that terminates TLS, X-Forwarded-For might be present but TCP srcIP lost. If they need guaranteed TCP src IP, confirm LB preserves it.

elaine (AE): Thanks team — I'll attach the checklist to the RFP reply and upload their questionnaire when it arrives.
